config:
[protection]
enabled = true
paths = ["guarded/**"]

[validators.git.commit]
severity = "warning"

[providers.claude]
enabled = true

tool_input.command: touch warned.txt && git commit --allow-empty -m "feat(api): add smoke"

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: klaudiush warning: Not blocking. [GIT010] Git commit missing required flags: -s -S. Add -sS flags to your command, keeping ALL existing arguments. Example: git commit -sS -m "your message"

response.systemMessage:
⚠️ Warning GIT010: Git commit missing required flags: -s -S
  Fix: Add -sS flags to your command, keeping ALL existing arguments. Example: git commit -sS -m "your message"
  Ref: https://klaudiu.sh/e/GIT010

Git commit must use -sS flags (signoff + GPG sign)

Current command: git commit 
Expected: git commit -sS -m "message"
